summary: cro checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: CRO handoff: when capacity clears, validate the MarkItDown opportunity in a disposable worktree only. Evidence: MIT license, 194 files, 22 purpose-specific keyword hits, and 8/8 bounded lab checks passed; dependencies were not installed and maintenance/security fit remain unverified. Fleet use case: normalize existing source documents into reviewable Markdown for SEO/content QA. Smallest prototype: process five already-authorized local documents, compare headings, links, tables, and metadata against source files, and discard the artifact. Metric: editorial acceptance rate and extraction defect count; time-to-learn: one engineering cycle. Roll back by deleting the disposable artifact; no production or telemetry change.

CRO handoff: when capacity clears, validate a single shadcn/ui component in an isolated worktree. Evidence: MIT license, 3,198 files, 10 purpose-specific keyword hits, and 3/3 bounded lab checks passed; dependencies were not installed and framework compatibility, supply-chain risk, and maintenance burden remain unverified. Fleet use case: standardize accessible CTA/navigation primitives for future site work without imposing a runtime dependency. Smallest prototype: copy one component pattern into a disposable fixture, run existing build and keyboard/accessibility checks, then discard it. Metric: build pass, accessibility pass, bundle/dependency delta, and implementation time; time-to-learn: one engineering cycle. No production deployment or cross-site rollout is proposed.
